local_state_rules: Grid cells, vector currents, drifter particles, time steps, eddy markers, and uncertainty cones form one flow state.
Changing wind forcing, tide phase, or ensemble member changes arrows, streamlines, drifter paths, beaching risk, and station readouts together.
A drifter path must be integrated through the current field and cannot remain stale when the vector field changes.
Map, vector field, streamlines, particle trails, eddy diagnostics, uncertainty plume, and challenge feedback derive from one current state.
difficulty_profile: vector map, streamlines, particle trails, eddy markers, ensemble spread, station readouts, and risk warnings stay synchronized
later turns add wind/tide controls, eddy detection, ensemble uncertainty, and rescue-route diagnosis
hardness comes from field-to-trajectory consistency: changing the current field must move paths, risk zones, and uncertainty together
visual object must look like an ocean operations visualization console
task_world.visual_object_requirement: Render an ocean map with vector arrows, streamlines, drifter particles, trail history, eddy rings, coast/beaching zones, station markers, ensemble plume, and time slider.

validation_scenarios.name: baseline linked visual model
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T1 asks for the baseline interactive visualization.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI shows the ocean current ensemble visualization lab with a domain-native primary visual, visible controls, and derived readouts from one canonical state. Pass requires executed UI evidence for the stated mechanism; component presence, source-code intent, or a single easy happy path is insufficient. Actor reference: verify the action/evidence checklist through visible UI operations; do not finish success from component presence, source intent, or an unrelated easier interaction.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Synthetic data and approximate deterministic local rules are acceptable; judge state consistency and visible evidence, not external real-world fidelity. Do not let actor/evaluator substitute an easier example after a public or UI-advertised boundary case fails; count stale linked views, dummy controls, and impossible success states as real failures. If actor tooling cannot operate a visible drag/slider directly, try an actor-supported visible alternative on the same control; if the primary mechanism remains unreachable, record that as evidence instead of substituting a different feature.

evidence_requirements.expect: Render an ocean map with vector arrows, streamlines, drifter particles, trail history, eddy rings, coast/beaching zones, station markers, ensemble plume, and time slider.
baseline state is consistent across visible surfaces

evidence_requirements.surface: visible controls / primary visual / derived readouts
evidence_requirements.expect: At least two independent surfaces change consistently from the same canonical state; a static diagram plus unrelated readout is insufficient.
evidence_requirements.action: Use the most central state-changing control for this turn. First record the visible baseline value on the control plus at least two dependent surfaces, then change the control through a visible UI action. If a range click does not change the value, try direct text input on that same range/text control before giving up. Do not use source code alone as evidence.
evidence_requirements.evidence: Quote the exact before and after control value plus two dependent visible outputs such as readout value, plotted marker, warning text, selected item, table row, or diagram label. If only the control label changes while dependent surfaces do not, report partial or failure.

evidence_requirements.expect: The UI must either update according to the domain rule or explicitly explain why the state is impossible; stale values, impossible success states, or generic success text count as failure.
evidence_requirements.action: Exercise one high/low, valid/invalid, legal/blocked, narrow/wide, or correct/wrong contrast that is directly implied by the public request. Prefer a contrast with a predicted qualitative outcome, not a cosmetic setting.
evidence_requirements.evidence: Record the attempted contrast, the expected domain outcome, and the observed UI outcome. Do not replace a failed public or UI-advertised contrast with an easier passing example when deciding success.

evidence_requirements.expect: All linked surfaces must agree on the same selected entity/time/range/threshold; a view that still shows stale out-of-range data is failure.
evidence_requirements.action: Use the primary selection, filter, threshold, brush, or range control and inspect every linked surface named by the public request. If direct dragging fails, try visible numeric range inputs, preset buttons, keyboard focus plus arrow keys, or direct input on the same control when available; if no visible path works, report the primary interaction as unreachable rather than substituting an unrelated card click.
evidence_requirements.evidence: Record the selected value/range and at least three linked surfaces when present. Name any surface that remains out of sync, unchanged, or unreachable.

evidence_requirements.expect: The system must conserve or propagate state according to the domain rule; isolated marker changes without rerouting, invalidation, propagation, or reachability changes are failure.
evidence_requirements.action: Change a route, partition, valve, connection, node, or path and inspect both local and downstream/global consequences. Prefer a contrast that should clearly reroute, isolate, conserve, or invalidate something.
evidence_requirements.evidence: Quote the changed connection/node/path and before/after values or states for the affected branch plus at least one downstream/global surface.

turns.prompt: Explain how ocean drifter trajectories reveal current fields, then build an interactive visualization with vector arrows, streamlines, drifter particles, trail history, and station readouts.
Add wind forcing and tide phase controls. The vector field, streamlines, drifter paths, and beaching-risk warning should update together.
Add eddy detection and let me seed multiple drifters around an eddy. Show rotation direction, trapping risk, and which drifters escape.
Add ensemble uncertainty plumes and a before/after comparison while preserving current wind, tide, drifter seed points, and eddy selection.
Add a rescue-route diagnosis challenge where I choose which drifter is most likely to beach, then explain the evidence from current vectors, trails, and ensemble spread.
